subject: Small delay on the file handoff
text: Hey, sorry to bother you early, but my train from the north terminal was cancelled because of a signal fault, and the replacement bus is crawling through roadworks. I will still finish the caption set before the client call, but I may hand it over an hour later than planned. If that messes with the review queue, you can keep moving on the layout pass; I will pick it up as soon as the connection settles. I appreciate your patience, especially on such a messy morning. Thanks a lot.
